question: Find the x-coordinates of the intersections of \(y=x\) and \(y=4/x\).
solution: Combining the equations gives \(x=4/x\), so \(x^2=4\) and \(x=\pm2\). The corresponding intersection points are \((2,2)\) and \((-2,-2)\).
